title: Update on Incident where Social Media Post was Taken Down by Israeli Embassy in Singapore
what_it_is: Update on Incident where Social Media Post was Taken Down by Israeli Embassy in Singapore

sections.label: Israeli embassy social media posting
sections.summary: Asked whether further steps will be taken and whether a person responsible for a foreign embassy's social media posting has diplomatic immunity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs with regard to the social media posting that was taken down by the Israeli embassy in Singapore on 24 March 2024 (a) whether there are further steps to be taken; and (b) whether a person responsible for such posting on a social media account that is owned or managed by a foreign embassy in Singapore will enjoy diplomatic immunity from jurisdiction and prosecution under our laws.

sections.label: Reports of offensive remarks
sections.summary: Police received 43 reports of alleged offensive remarks or actions against Jewish or Muslim communities between 7 October 2023 and 31 March 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Between 7 October 2023 and 31 March 2024, the Police received 43 reports regarding alleged offensive remarks or actions targeted at members of the Jewish or Muslim communities in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: The Government will intervene against acts which can affect our social harmony.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Members know we have laws such as the Maintenance of Religious Harmony Act, the Penal Code has provisions, the Protection from Harassment Act – they all set out the boundaries on what is acceptable conduct.

sections.label: MFA on the post
sections.summary: MFA agreed that the post was offside and should be taken down.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: MFA agreed that the post was offside and should be taken down.

sections.label: Officer sent back
sections.summary: The post was not authorised by him and the officer responsible will be sent back, away from Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: The post was not authorised by him and the officer responsible for the post will be sent back, away from Singapore.

sections.label: No further action taken
sections.summary: The Police, in consultation with the Attorney-General's Chambers, assessed that no further action was to be taken.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: The Police, in consultation with the Attorney-General’s Chambers, have assessed that no further action was to be taken.

sections.label: Restraining orders and sovereign immunity
sections.summary: No restraining order has been issued in nearly 30 years, but for an embassy the starting point is sovereign immunity.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Though the very fact that we have never issued a restraining order since the legislation came into force – I think it is nearly 30 years – shows how useful the legislation has been and also shows the nature of the community we have in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: But if it is specifically an embassy, the starting point is there would be sovereign immunity.

sections.label: Handling embassy post cases
sections.summary: The way to handle an embassy putting up a post is to talk to the embassy.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: In these cases, when an embassy puts up a post, I think the way to handle it is the way we handled it – talk to the embassy.

sections.label: Prosecution assessment after immunity waiver
sections.summary: Where immunity is waived, the prosecution can assess the case's nature if it may stir anger and create a violent spectacle.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: The Romanians charged him after he went back to Romania.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: So, if there is a case where immunity is waived, then the short answer to the question, Sir, is that the prosecution can make an assessment as to the nature of the case if it feels that this may stir up anger and create a spectacle with potentially violent consequences.
